TABLE.NAME: block_enrolmenttimer
TABLE.COMMENT: Queued enrolment expiry warnings, one row per user enrolment

FIELD.NAME: enrolid
FIELD.COMMENT: user_enrolments.id this alert is for, despite the field name

FIELD.NAME: alerttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the alert should be sent to the user

FIELD.NAME: sent
FIELD.COMMENT: Flag if the email for this enrol instance has been sent

INDEX.NAME: enrolid
INDEX.COMMENT: Looked up on every task run to avoid queueing duplicates
